envelope.description: Bind in the attempt's format and report all reuse refusals at once

body.title: Bind in the attempt's format and report all reuse refusals at once
body.summary: bindTaskFinalIdentities resolves its format (header field, else v1 for accepted, v2 for pending), records taskIdentityFormat on a newly accepted candidate, and passes the format to the reuse check. requireReuseIdentity gains the optional format parameter and refuses a cross-format source. Source checks still throw at once; format and identity refusals are collected and raised as one TaskReviewInputError (single refusal unchanged).
acceptanceChecks: Provenance-only edits keep reuse of a v2 source, for one task and for three tasks in one submission.
A real test change still refuses reuse with the existing reassess text.
Three tasks whose source is v1 are refused in one rejection naming all three, costing one attribution submission.
Malformed reuse decisions (not earlier, foreign-party) still fail at once with the existing origins error.
Saved v1 attempts, including a v1 attempt that reused a v1 attempt, re-bind unchanged.
A published v2 reuse row passes validateTaskBody's reuse-identity check.
Existing attribution-binding and compatibility tests pass unchanged.
